entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:1
segments: ¶Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; Thine eyes are doves behind thy veil; Thy hair is as a flock of goats, On the slopes of mount Gilead.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:2
segments: Thy teeth are like a flock of shorn sheep, Which go up from the washing; Which have all borne twins, And none is barren among them.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:3
segments: Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, And thy speech is comely; As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples Behind thy veil.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:4
segments: Thy neck is like the tower of David, Built for an armoury: A thousand bucklers hang thereon, All shields of mighty men.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:5
segments: Thy two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, Which feed among the lilies.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:6
segments: Until the day dawn, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, And to the hill of frankincense.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:7
segments: Thou art all fair, my love; And there is no spot in thee.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:8
segments: ¶[Come] with me, from Lebanon, [my] spouse, With me from Lebanon, --Come, look from the top of Amanah, From the top of Senir and Hermon, From the lions' dens, From the mountains of the leopards.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:9
segments: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, [my] spouse; Thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, With one chain of thy neck.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:10
segments: How fair is thy love, my sister, [my] spouse! How much better is thy love than wine! And the fragrance of thine ointments than all spices!

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:11
segments: Thy lips, [my] spouse, drop [as] the honeycomb; Honey and milk are under thy tongue; And the smell of thy garments is like the smell of Lebanon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:12
segments: A garden enclosed is my sister, [my] spouse; A spring shut up, a fountain sealed.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:13
segments: Thy shoots are a paradise of pomegranates, with precious fruits; Henna with spikenard plants;

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:14
segments: Spikenard and saffron; Calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; Myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:15
segments: ¶A fountain in the gardens, A well of living waters, Which stream from Lebanon.

entries.title: Song of Solomon 4:16
segments: Awake, north wind, and come, [thou] south; Blow upon my garden, [that] the spices thereof may flow forth. Let my beloved come into his garden, And eat its precious fruits.
